title: Mixed-model line changeover SOP
content: Standard changeover sequence: clear line → swap tooling cart → verify torque recipes → run 3 golden units before full rate. Typical times: Spark 20 min, Pulse 22 min, Nova 28 min, Ridge 25 min, Apex 32 min.
contentZh: 标准换型顺序：清线 → 更换工装车 → 验证扭矩配方 → 试跑3台金样后全速。典型时间：火花车型20分钟、脉冲车型22分钟、星云车型28分钟、山脊车型25分钟、巅峰车型32分钟。

title: OEE calculation on Line 1
titleZh: 1号线综合设备效率计算方法
content: OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality. Availability excludes planned maintenance. Performance compares actual VPH to model-specific target. Quality uses FTT from quality gate station st-60.
contentZh: 综合设备效率等于可用率、性能率与质量率的乘积。可用率不含计划维护。性能率对比实际每小时产量与车型目标。质量率采用六十号工位质量门的一次通过率。

title: HV isolation test troubleshooting
titleZh: 高压绝缘测试故障排查
content: If EOL-HV tests fail intermittently, check inverter harness torque at st-30, verify supplier batch on DC-400 inverter, and inspect isolation washer seating.
contentZh: 若下线高压测试间歇失败，检查三十号工位逆变器线束扭矩、指定逆变器批次及隔离垫圈安装。

title: Supplier quantity issue escalation
titleZh: 供应商数量异常升级流程
content: Auto-flag when OTIF <92% or 3+ quantity variances in 90 days. Purchasing opens CAPA; production plan receives alternate source options within 48h.
contentZh: 准时足量交付率低于百分之九十二，或九十天内出现三次数量差异时自动标记。采购启动纠正预防措施；四十八小时内提供备选货源。

title: Demand signal to production plan flow
titleZh: 需求信号到生产计划流程
content: Ontology-processed news adjusts weekly demand forecast. Planner auto-run optimises mix on single line considering changeover matrix, holidays, and staffing caps per shift (max 48 FTE shift A).
contentZh: 本体处理新闻后调整周需求预测。计划自动运行并优化单线车型组合，考虑换型矩阵、假日与各班次人力上限（甲班最多四十八人）。
